Previous lessons:
Reordering onboarding flows can produce major wins (up to +12.0%), but carries risk of severe drops (-8.9%) or no clear effect, with predictions often being inaccurate.
Targeted copy changes for account persistence (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful, with launch CTA performance underpredicted (+0.5% predicted vs +6.7% measured); general intro copy showed no clear effect.
Interactive flows (+7.2%) and interactive waiting screen enhancements (+3.9%) were helpful and outperformed initial predictions, though a new preview screen showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns yielded zero winning tests and carried severe downside risk (down to -19.3%), consistently performing worse than predicted or showing no clear effect.
Hints showed no wins, either actively hurting performance (-3.1%) or producing no clear effect.
Notifications and layout changes showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Reordering flow steps generated several significant wins (up to +12.0%), but carries severe downside risk (-8.9%) and frequently showed no clear effect.
Interactive flows (+6.5% to +7.2%) and interactive waiting screen features (+3.9%) were helpful and beat predictions.
UI redesigns failed to yield any wins, often caused severe performance drops (down to -19.3%), and performed worse than predicted.
Targeted copy updates were helpful for account persistence (+3.5%) and launch actions (+6.7%), though other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Hints produced no wins, either actively hurting performance (-3.1%) or showing no clear effect.
Notifications, layout changes, and standalone preview screens showed no clear effect across all rounds.
